subject.title: fix(sessions): ignore invalid saved timestamps during session recovery

question: Should OpenClaw treat pre-existing non-RFC3339-but-Date.parse-accepted session timestamps as unsupported malformed metadata, or preserve/migrate them during upgrade?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent, but it changes interpretation of existing persisted user state across several runtime surfaces; source review cannot safely choose the permanent compatibility promise without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt strict timestamps with migration
options.body: Keep the strict runtime parser and add a narrowly scoped Doctor migration plus upgrade tests for historical values maintainers intend to preserve.

options.title: Adopt strict omission without migration
options.body: Treat all non-canonical string timestamps as unsupported malformed metadata and document that recovery falls back to existing non-timestamp metadata.

options.title: Preserve legacy parsing
options.body: Retain the existing permissive interpretation for reachable historical transcripts and limit strict parsing to newly introduced or explicitly external inputs.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict timestamps with migration
recommendation.body: Keep the strict runtime parser and add a narrowly scoped Doctor migration plus upgrade tests for historical values maintainers intend to preserve.

likelyOwner.reason: A core product decision is needed because the affected persisted-state contract spans multiple core and UI consumers.
